mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS id, u.company_id AS companyId, u.name AS name, u.type_id AS typeId, u.code AS code, u.parent_id AS parentId, COUNT(e.id) AS employeeCount FROM units u LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.unit_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{id} GROUP BY u.id, u.name

SELECT u.id AS id, u.company_id AS companyId, u.name AS name, u.type_id AS typeId, u.code AS code, u.parent_id AS parentId, COUNT(e.id) AS employeeCount FROM units u LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.unit_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY u.id
SELECT parent.* FROM units child LEFT JOIN units parent ON parent.id = child.parent_id WHERE child.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM employees e WHERE e.unit_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO units (company_id, name, type_id, code, parent_id) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{name}, #{typeId}, #{code}, #{parentId})
mapper.update: UPDATE units SET company_id = #{companyId}, name = #{name}, type_id = #{typeId}, code = #{code}, parent_id = #{parentId} WHERE id = #{id}
